name: Helping Missionaries
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively support missionaries who carry the gospel to all nations, recognizing that receiving them is equivalent to receiving Christ and the One who sent Him. The church is entrusted to care for and nurture those who preach, as they are overseen by the Holy Spirit and serve as spiritual guides. Demonstrating consistent good works and sincere faith sets a vital example for others, while practical support, as shown in the Thessalonian believers' repeated aid, is a tangible expression of partnership in the gospel mission.
